M1.name: ELIGIBLE_IDENTITY_LEAF_MATERIALIZATION_MS
M1.implementation: in-process sequential wp5Hash([identityDomain, selectedVoterSecret + index]) for index 0..N-1

prewarm.recipe: one wp5Hash call plus one 1-leaf buildWp5MerkleSnapshot call before the first observation in each campaign process
prewarm.purpose: exclude one-time Poseidon/backend initialization from M1 and M2

untimedValidationPerObservation: generated controlled input must deep-equal the frozen R3B input for the same N
target pathBits must remain all zero
public signal array must contain exactly 73 signals
all 73 public signals must bind to the controlled input
verification log must semantically match snarkJS:\s*OK! after ANSI/CR sanitization
failedObservationRetention: preserve all files and stop campaign; no automatic retry
defaultFinalPolicyCandidate: 5 warmup plus 20 measured observations per N
reductionPolicy: any reduction due proving burden must be justified and frozen only after excluded pilot evidence
interpretationGuardrails: report N and configured Merkle depth together
do not equate occupied leaf count N with Merkle path depth
do not claim pure path extraction timing
do not infer causal opcode cost
do not compare local cryptographic stage latency directly with published 10-15 second biometric/IoT end-to-end voting time
no on-chain eligible-set scaling claim is authorized by this campaign
